fact: The government's Programme national de connectivité rurale, 'Nos villages connectés', began a pilot with 17 villages in July 2025 within a plan to connect 575 rural localities by end 2025, 210 of them carried by ANSUT.
title: Connectivité rurale : la Côte d'Ivoire étend le projet « Nos villages connectés » aux zones les plus isolées
